data.description:
## Goal
As a publisher, I want pack entitlement resolved behind a pure interface with a deterministic fake, so the launcher builds and works without Steam and packs can be gated without leaking content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `electron/card-pack-entitlements.ts` defines `PackEntitlementSource` (availability + `isEntitled(pack)`) with a deterministic `FakeEntitlementSource` and a capability-ordered Steam adapter using `apps.isDlcInstalled` (dynamically imported; never throws; unavailable resolves to locked).
- A config-driven pack→DLC catalog maps pack ids to Steam app ids as data, not hard-coded titles.
- `window.tce.cardPacks` exposes pack status/list over the context bridge; the renderer never imports the Steamworks SDK.
- `electron/main.ts` registers the `tce-packs://` scheme and handler with the resolved content directory.
- With no Steam or no content directory, the API returns base-content/locked status and never crashes.

## Minimal Implementation
- Mirror the `electron/steam-follow*.ts` and `electron/steam-achievements*.ts` structure; add `electron/card-pack-ipc.ts` (pure handler table), preload exposure, and main-process wiring.

## Dependencies
- Pack URL builder & tce-packs protocol.

## Deliverables
- Entitlement modules + IPC + preload/main wiring + `tests/electron/card-pack-entitlements.test.ts` (+ an IPC test).

## Test Plan
- Unit: fake source, Steam-absent degradation, entitled/unentitled, catalog lookup, IPC handler totals.

data.description:
## Goal
As a player, I want installed, entitled packs discovered automatically and shown in an in-game listing, so I can see and toggle new content without a rebuild.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `src/ui/CardPackLoader.ts` discovers `<contentDir>/packs/manifest.json` via an injected `fetchManifest`, filters by `gameId` + compatibility + entitlement, fetches CSV fragments/assets via `tce-packs://`, and never throws, returning structural `{ packs, incompatible, locked, errors }`.
- `src/ui/card-pack-client.ts` is total when `window.tce` is absent (returns base content / no packs).
- `CardPackListing.ts` renders installed/unlocked/locked rows with a lock reason and an enable/disable control, positioned entirely via SLL anchors (no hard-coded pixel coordinates).
- Locked packs cannot be enabled; entitled packs are enabled by default.
- The loader takes injectable `{ contentDir, engineVersion, fetchManifest, fetchCsv, importer }` so tests need no Electron or network.

## Minimal Implementation
- Port the `GamePluginLoader.ts` discovery/filter/never-throw pattern; build the listing from `anchorPoint()` / SLL zones.

## Dependencies
- Base+pack CSV merge & merged checksum; Pack URL builder & tce-packs protocol; Pack entitlement seam & launcher wiring.

## Deliverables
- Three modules + `tests/ui/card-pack-loader.test.ts` + a listing test.

## Test Plan
- Unit: discovery, filters, degradation paths, listing state/toggle, an assertion that positioning is SLL-only.

## Implementation evidence — consolidation (CG-0MUZFNOE1007T57S)

Implemented as a single coherent docs chore on one worktree. The planned
children F1–F5 are all satisfied by this one commit because F1 (the guard test)
is red by design until F2/F4 land, so it cannot be a standalone green commit
(the finish gate requires a green full suite). This is documented as a
deviation from strict one-commit-per-child.

### F1 — docs-consistency guard (TDD red → green)

- **RED evidence:** `npx vitest run --project unit tests/tooling/creating-a-new-game-guide.test.ts`
  → `6 failed | 1 passed` before the guide/skill landed (guide missing, skill
  still 842 lines with retired phrases, README unreachable).
- **GREEN evidence:** after F2/F3/F4 → `7 passed`.

### F2 — canonical guide

- New `docs/dev/creating-a-new-game.md`: ten lifecycle stages (concept,
  intake/plan, scaffold/multi-repo, architecture/implementation, testing, CI/
  release, registration, assets/licensing, docs, publication), each a short
  orientation + copy-pasteable commands + links to the authoritative deep dives.
- Links (not restates) multi-repo-architecture.md, game-configuration.md,
  per-game-src-layout-decision.md, docs/DEVELOPER.md deep dives, and the
  skill's §17 checklist.
- References reduced motion, Steam achievements (optional), runtime plugins
  (optional), and the `dev`-only / never-`main` rule.

### F3 — de-duplication and indexing

- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` §Adding an Example Game reduced to a short pointer; its
  technical reference retained under the new `## Game Repository Setup &
  Publication` section (ToC updated).
- `README.md` Contributing section links the guide; reciprocal links added from
  `docs/dev/multi-repo-architecture.md` and `docs/dev/game-configuration.md`.

### F4 — skill slimmed and corrected

`.pi/skills/tce-game-dev/SKILL.md`: 842 → 168 lines. Retains §1 (when to use),
§16 (Common Pitfalls) and §17 (single authoritative definition-of-done
checklist). Multi-repo facts corrected (sibling `../tce-<game>` + `./core`,
`GAME_INFO` + `configs/*.json`, `CORE_ROOT=./core`, core carries no games).

**Per-section removal audit (each trimmed section covered elsewhere or
relocated):**

| Removed section | Disposition |
|---|---|
| §2 Project Structure (flat monorepo) | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md#project-structure`; corrected facts kept in skill §2 |
| §3 Game Architecture | Covered by `AGENTS.md` “Game Architecture Best Practices” |
| §4 Scene Lifecycle | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` (CardGameScene, replay) |
| §5 SLL | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md#screen-layout-language-sll` |
| §6 HUD & UI | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md#shared-hud-components` |
| §7 Audio & Sound | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` SFX convention + animation/SFX section |
| §8 Accessibility | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` + `AGENTS.md` |
| §9 Data Persistence | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` (SaveLoad/Checkpoint/Transcript/Undo) |
| §10 AI Strategies | Covered by `AGENTS.md` pattern 4 |
| §11 Testing | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md#testing` + AGENTS.md profiles |
| §12 CI/CD | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` + AGENTS.md quality gates |
| §13 Card System | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` (Hand & Pile, Shared Renderer) |
| §14 Shared Engine Modules | Covered by `DEVELOPER.md` + AGENTS.md Components |
| §15 Modal Dialogs | Covered by `AGENTS.md` modal-dialog best practices |
| §17 “completeness verification” prelude | Stale (`example-games/<game>/` audit); folded into the corrected §17 checklist + guide |
| §1/§16/§17 | Retained (intake Q3) |

No unique convention was silently dropped; retained content is the pitfalls and
checklist, plus a new centralised “Multi-repo facts” block.

### F5 — verification

- `npm run build` green.
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/tooling/creating-a-new-game-guide.test.ts` green.
- Full suite run by the finish gate (evidence in the commit comment).
